decision: NO_PRODUCTION_ADDITIONS — HUMAN QUALITY REVIEW REQUIRED; ONE ADDITIONAL RUNTIME BATCH UNAVAILABLE
executiveSummary: The repaired verifier passed sample-029 in three independent runs for both completed candidate batches. Across the 33 unique candidate videos actually runtime-tested, 12 passed sustained playback and 21 returned YouTube Error 150. All technical passes remain Tier C because listening/visual quality, guide-vocal status, key, synchronization, transitions, and completeness were not independently verified. A final v5 attempt did not launch because Playwright was not resolvable, so its two candidates remain untested. No medleys or primary songs were changed.

qualityTierCountsAcrossReconciledResearc.note: No S/A/B grade is defensible without actual audio/presentation review. The 12 C records are technical runtime passes only; the other 36 have no unique runtime qualification and include weak, incomplete, or semantically redundant leads rather than 36 presumed viable additions.

methods.discovery: Targeted public YouTube/channel searches and public descriptions/timestamps; existing research ledgers were reconciled rather than overwritten. No YouTube Data API, API key, downloads, proxy, or rehosting.
methods.runtime: tools/run-playability-audit.mjs driving youtube-playability-audit.html and the existing src/youtube.js official IFrame Player API controller in Playwright Chromium.
methods.passDefinition: The actual loaded ID matched; onReady and PLAYING were observed; currentTime advanced over at least 15 seconds with repeated readable samples and advancing intervals. READY or PLAYING alone is not PASS.
methods.popularity: Public lifetime view-count snapshots and publication dates where available, captured 2026-10-07. These are not search-volume data. Provider-relative velocity and time-series momentum were not available; view velocity/search volume/current trend are UNKNOWN.
methods.qualityConstraint: The headless audit cannot listen to the audio or establish visual lyric synchronization, key, guide vocals, transitions, or completion quality. No such properties are claimed.

rootCauses: The YouTube API replaces the controller mount element with its iframe, so a mount-scoped iframe lookup could lose the active frame identity.
The iframe src can retain the initial video ID while loadVideoById changes the active media; requested ID alone did not prove actual loaded-media identity.
The controller emits load-accepted on later media switches; this is not a new player-lifecycle onReady callback.
The old sustained gate did not sufficiently prove playback continued through the end of its observation interval.
correction: Use the official player's getVideoUrl() as read-only loaded-media identity evidence.
Record requested and loaded IDs, lifecycle, connected iframe, playback state, duration/currentTime samples, visibility/focus, and advancing intervals.
Require a full sustained observation window with fresh final samples, repeated advancement, and advancement near the end of the window; callbacks alone never pass.
Require three independent sample-029 control runs before the candidate batch; stop if any control fails.

v5Attempt.reason: Runner failed before browser launch: Playwright is not resolvable in this invocation. No v5 control or candidate results were produced.

deduplication.existingLibrary: All 11 current medleys were compared by artist/theme and known section lists. Primary song/video data is separate and unchanged.
notable: Avoid an additional generic OPM love-song medley overlapping current OPM entries; MjJnLgAW1jc is also Error 150.
Aegis alternatives are redundant against the existing Aegis medley unless a manual track-list comparison proves distinctive value.
Renz Verano has two sustained-playback candidates; compare their distinct sets before considering either or both.
The Freddie Aguilar candidate overlaps three songs with the existing medley but adds five documented sections; treat as a distinct longer experience only if manual review confirms the set.
J Brothers variants overlap substantially; only one distinct user-valued version should be considered.

productionDecision.why: No candidate reached S/A/B because available tools did not genuinely verify audio/presentation properties. The v5 candidate tester also could not launch. Do not promote technical playback evidence as overall quality.
humanReviewCanAdvance: Manually inspect/listen to top shortlist candidates in KantaCue or official watch pages; record observations before any S/A/B decision.
productionDecision.nextResearchBatch: Restore a known Playwright runtime path for the audit runner, re-run sample-029 3/3 before any further candidate tests, then runtime-test Donna Cruz and Men Oppose candidates. Keep the same 15-second gate.

limitations: No actual audio listening or frame-by-frame visual quality review was performed.
Search volume is unknown; view counts are public lifetime snapshots, not search counts or current velocity.
Fourteen newly discovered candidates were deferred/not runtime-tested; reasons are recorded individually.
The v5 runtime manifest was prepared but its run failed before Playwright/browser launch; it yielded no candidate evidence.
Public embed eligibility and playback can change after the test date.
